HediffDef.label: near-death insight
HediffDef.description: A brush with death in hostile combat has offered a fleeting glimpse of reverse cursed energy. Recover from being downed within ten days for one awakening chance: 5%, or 10% if reverse cursed technique training was researched when the injury occurred. Further downings cannot offer another chance until this condition expires. This insight does not heal injuries or restore cursed energy.
